content: Service role key bypasses RLS entirely (server-side admin use only, keep secret). When a backend verifies the user JWT itself and then queries with the service role, RLS becomes defense-in-depth not primary gate. Alternative: pass user JWT to PostgREST so RLS enforces per-row access via auth.uid(). Best practice: store roles/tenant in app_metadata (NOT user_metadata, which end users can modify) for JWT-claim-based policies avoiding subqueries. For anti-lock-in Express-in-front design, Express is the authorization gate; RLS is a safety net if you also enable it with policies keyed on user_id.
